cards.title: Moon Muffin Last Crumb Tuck
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline backpack ending card for choosing a gentle make-believe market ending before the page is finished: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place the card beside a blank backpack flap shape and offer two pretend moon-market ending choices: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Pick the ending that best fits the moon muffin mix-up and write the final choice on paper: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: The moon muffin helper finally chooses to ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling check: At the final crumb counter, the helper feels ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: Bring back one earlier market item before the ending: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo line: Repeat one tiny word or clue from the beginning in the ending: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: Write the last market sentence with a soft landing: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: Add one moon-market detail that makes the choice clearer: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle one ending choice and copy only three final words: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this card to finish another pretend market tale with one clear choice: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Soft Stamp Close
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper-only backpack ending card for ending a fictional puddle mail tale by naming the final feeling: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Set out the card and ask which pretend ripple-mail feeling should end the story: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the ending by showing how the puddle mail helper feels after the tiny mix-up settles: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: The ripple-mail helper can finish by sorting, waiting, or asking for help: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling ending: The helper feels ____________________ because the puddle mail is finally ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: Bring back one pretend stamp, tag, or shell slip near the last line: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo line: Let the final ripple echo an earlier sound or word: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: End with one calm puddle-planet sentence: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: Replace one plain feeling word with a stronger puddle word: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Choose one feeling word first, then fill the ending blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Finish another pretend mail tale by naming the final feeling: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Ticket Comes Back
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable backpack ending card for ending a fictional library-train tale by returning one important object: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place a small paper ticket shape beside this card and invite an invented object return: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Finish the library-train story by bringing back an object that mattered earlier: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: The traveler ends by keeping, returning, or trading the ticket clue: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: When the object returns, the traveler feels ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: The earlier object that comes back in the last scene is ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo line: Repeat one shelf, bell, wheel, or bookmark clue in the ending: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: Write the last library-train sentence after the object returns: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: Add one object detail so the ending feels connected to the beginning: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the returning object, then write one ending word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Try an object-return ending in another invented train tale: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Map Question Loop
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline backpack ending card for ending a fictional bakery-map tale by echoing a question from earlier: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Read one pretend map question aloud and ask the writer to echo it near the ending: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Use the last line to answer or repeat one bakery-map question in a new way: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: The map-mender ends by folding, turning, or labeling the pretend map: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: After the question comes back, the map-mender feels ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: Bring back one button, crumb, ribbon, or folded corner in the ending: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Question echo: The question that comes back near the end is ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: Write a final sentence that answers the echoed question: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: Move one earlier question clue closer to the final line: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Copy the question mark shape and fill one answer word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: End another pretend map tale by echoing one question: ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Weather Tiny Blue Surprise
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable backpack ending card for adding one gentle fictional surprise to a teacup weather ending: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Choose one pretend weather symbol together and leave room for a tiny surprise at the end: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Finish the teacup weather story with a small surprise that stays gentle and make-believe: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: The weather watcher ends by opening, closing, or tapping the tiny pane: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: The small surprise makes the watcher feel ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: Bring back one saucer, ribbon, spoon, or cloud tag in the final moment: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo line: Let one earlier weather word return in the last sentence: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: Write the gentle surprise ending for Teacup Town: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: Make the surprise smaller, clearer, and more teacup-like: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the surprise symbol and write one final phrase: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Add one tiny surprise ending to another pretend weather tale: ____________________.

cards.title: Pocket Park Notice Tomorrow Hint
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper-only backpack ending card for closing a fictional notice-board tale with a broad next-day hint: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place this card beside a blank pretend notice and ask for an invented next-day hint only: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: End the pocket-park story by hinting at what the notice might invite next in the make-believe world: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: The notice helper ends by pinning, reading, or saving the pretend note: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: The helper feels ____________________ when the notice finally makes sense.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: Bring back one ribbon tack, leaf slip, or bench tag near the ending: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo line: Repeat one notice word from the beginning in the final hint: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: Write the next-day hint without naming any real place: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: Add one pocket-park detail that makes the hint feel ready but not finished: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Choose one hint word and place it on the pretend notice: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Make another broad next-day hint for a fictional notice-board ending: ____________________.
